say: Our runner's feet used to slide along the floor while he walked.
His legs swung back and forth on a timer while his body moved at its own speed, so the two never matched.
We measured it. While a foot was meant to be planted, it slid at ninety five percent of his walking speed.
sub: We measured it. While a foot was meant to be planted, it slid at 95% of his walking speed.

say: Now each step plants a foot at a fixed point on the floor, and the legs reach for it.
The hip, the knee and the foot form a triangle, and its side lengths give the angles of the hip and the knee on every frame.
Slip while walking dropped from ninety five percent of his speed to under one percent.
sub: Slip while walking dropped from 95% of his speed to under 1%.

say: He now walks and runs without sliding.
